purpose: Test corrected serialization alone with unchanged current prompt and same checkpoint; no training
technical_pass_criteria: No context overflow or infrastructure error
Every response is an accepted raw JSON action
behavior_gate: At least one accepted action changes a starting parameter
Record distinct accepted designs and their fixed verifier scores; failures cannot supply the only reward variation
stop_conditions: Stop after four calls or five minutes, whichever comes first
Stop on alignment or infrastructure failure
If the model only copies values, stop and report failure; no expanded sample or optimizer run
on_pass: Review the four trajectories before proposing any further experiment; passing does not authorize training
resource_note: Process timeout does not deallocate the TPU or stop idle allocation charges. Preserve files before any separately authorized resource deletion.
